interpretation: True two-stage f32 reduction control. serial_latency orders each partial and final dispatch and reuses shared state. independent_throughput uses disjoint slices with one intra-operation partial-to-final dependency per logical operation, distributed over matched HIP stream and Vulkan queue lanes. Vulkan cross-queue GPU span uses calibrated timestamps. GPU ratios are comparable; unlike host submission classes are intentionally not compared.

config.method: pre-recorded command buffer with block-partial dispatch plus final-reduce dispatch
